patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Mom) The back of the little remote was open and the shiny coin-battery is missing. She's drooling a lot and won't drink her juice, keeps gagging a little. She doesn't even look that sick, though.
presentation.triageNote: 3-year-old female, likely swallowed a coin-cell button battery from a remote, now drooling and refusing to drink with mild gagging, though she looks deceptively well.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because suspected button-battery ingestion with drooling and refusal to drink is a time-critical esophageal emergency.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This toddler may have a coin-cell battery lodged in the esophagus, with drooling, dysphagia, and gagging despite a deceptively well appearance.
clinical.acuityReason: A lodged battery can cause rapid caustic injury; symptoms of esophageal obstruction require immediate localization and removal planning.
expectedResources: Age- and timing-appropriate mitigation while awaiting removal
keyFindings: Missing coin-cell battery from a remote
Comfortable breathing and normal oxygen saturation
redFlags: Drooling and inability to swallow normally
teachingPoints: A well appearance does not exclude rapidly progressing tissue injury from a button battery.
The object must be distinguished from a coin and localized without delay.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Imaging would be followed by immediate endoscopic removal if the battery is in the esophagus and observation for tissue injury or complications.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 3-year-old girl in a dress, deceptively well-looking
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, drooling slightly, hand near her mouth
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 3-year-old girl in a dress, deceptively well-looking, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, drooling slightly, one hand near her mouth. Expression: uncomfortable and a bit gaggy. Clearly visible: drool on her chin and a hand near her mouth and throat. No text, no logos.
